name: camera-lens
description: A detachable camera lens with a barrel, focus ring and front glass.
useCase: Identify interchangeable camera lenses or lens equipment.
misuse: Use lens for a convex optical element or aperture for the exposure control.

16.reason: The complete barrel and focusing ring remain clear beside the full front glass.

24.reason: The larger barrel keeps its focus ring, full front rim and glass center distinct.
